claims.name: health-served-by-the-running-service
claims.risk: the new route passes the unit tests and is still a 404, or an error, in the service as it runs

claims.name: only-the-service-and-its-tests-changed
claims.risk: a small route grew other files, a version change, a saved artifact or a commit

claims.name: changed-path-run-in-the-service
claims.risk: no command the run executed requested the new path from the service, so it was checked only through a mock or a unit test

claims.name: result-read-or-unverified
claims.risk: the answer reports the route as working without quoting a response, or hides that the running path was not run

claims.name: only-own-process-ended
claims.risk: a process or port the run did not start was ended by name or by port
